comparison_assessments.accuracy_note: The lyric preserves the sequence of clean hands, a pure heart, refusal to give the soul over to what is empty, and refusal to swear falsely.
comparison_assessments.creative_liberties_note: Unbloodied specifies the innocence of the hands, and undivided interprets purity of heart as single devotion. Giving the soul over recasts lifting it up; the English leaves the Masoretic first-person suffix on 'my soul' unexpressed.
